mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate from its peak level signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent labor market weakness that triggers a fiscal stimulus response, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in the stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the UNRATE > 4.0% condition, or the average 5d return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in aggregate demand, which triggers a central bank rate cut and fiscal stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates policy responses.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-financial crisis recovery regime, a federal funds rate below 3.0% signals an ultra-loose monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS < 3.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth rate above 0.5% per month signals expanding labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite HOUST < 1400.0, or the average 60d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% indicates a supply shock that disrupts production and increases costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to stagflation concerns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and CPIAUCSL above 3.5% does not produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the early-cycle recovery regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% for three consecutive months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
